sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234484 (+ /rates and the public per-site search catalog)
https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/emery-bay-campground (alerts: only the forest-wide food storage and wilderness orders), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 26 tent/RV sites (16 reservable, 10 walk-up) plus two group loops for up to 75 people each. The Forest Service gives a 32-ft maximum trailer length, but recreation.gov lists the individual sites at 34-60 ft; 4 are pull-throughs, gravel driveways.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/emery-bay-campground ('Max trailer length is 32 feet') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234484 ('This Campground has 26 sites, 16 of which are reservable and 10 are walk-up sites', 'Two group campsites ... up to 75 guests on each separate loop') + public campsite catalog (4 Pull-Through driveways, site max lengths 34-60 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from early/mid June only, hauled in by truck and not a fill station: arrive with the RV tank full. The Forest Service amenity list says 'Potable water is not available at this site'.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234484 ('Vault toilets are provided. Also drinking water is provided after June 15th. Water is not a fill station so please come with your RV water full.'; notice 'Potable water is available for filling containers after June 1st. Please fill RVs prior to arrival, as water is hauled by truck to campground.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/emery-bay-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'Seasons of Use: Mid May - September'.

Concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact Flathead Valley Campgrounds line 406-752-7924). 16 reservable sites, 10 first-come walk-up sites marked W. Reserved sites are held until 11 a.m. the day after arrival; reservation holders may not move to a walk-up site. 16 consecutive days (group sites 10). Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234484 (overview, notices, maxConsecutiveStay 16) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/emery-bay-campground ('16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF campground on the east side of Hungry Horse Reservoir, off East Side Reservoir Road near Martin City; boat ramp, host on site. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + Forest Service: confirmed 26 sites (16 reservable, 10 walk-up), 32-ft FS trailer maximum (rec.gov lists 34-60 ft sites, noted), no hookups, vault toilets, seasonal hauled water, recreation.gov booking with FCFS sites, $22/night (2026 rate table; FS page's $18 is older, fees left). Added season mid May - September, 4 pull-throughs, 16-day limit. Note trimmed of restated values and corrected 'west shore' to the east side (address East Side Reservoir Rd).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: recreation.gov's catalog marks 5 sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'; the entry says not waterfront.
max_rig_ft: the Forest Service says 'Max trailer length is 32 feet' while recreation.gov lists every standard site at 34-60 ft; kept the Forest Service figure.
